{{Quote|Alive, but his life force flickers. We must get him to the sickbay immediately.|Sayar Dun'La, on an injured Gar Stazi|<ref name="Legacy 42">[[Legacy (2006) 42|''Legacy'' (2006) 42]]</ref>}}
'''Medical bay''', also known as a '''medbay''', '''medical bay''', '''medical center''', or '''medical wing''' and informally called a '''sick bay''' or '''sickbay''', was a room or area on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] where the sick and injured were healed. It was similar to a [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] or a hospital. Sick bays could be found on both military and civilian vessels, and in some instances in non-mobile bases, throughout thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history. They were often furnished with hospital [[Sleeper (furniture)|beds]] and [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]], and they could be staffed by [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] and [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] alike. The sick bay aboard the [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']] also included [[ammonia chamber]]s, where [[Species/Legends|species]] that breathed [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]] could recuperate after prolonged exposure to [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]].

==Description==
{{Quote|You'll never learn, will you? You belong in sick bay. This time we'll have Too-Onebee knock you out.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]], to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="The Truce at Bakura">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>}}
Sick bay was the name given to an area on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] where the sick and injured were healed.<ref name="Hero's Trial" /> Also known as sickbay,<ref name="Legacy 42" /> medbay,<ref name="Death Troopers" /> a medical bay,<ref name="Ships of the Smuggler's Alliance">{{GamerCite|4|Ships of the Smuggler's Alliance}}</ref> a medical center,<ref name="Empire 6">[[Empire 6|''Empire'' 6]]</ref> or a medical wing,<ref name="EGTVAV 21">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'' {{C|"Chu'unthor"}}</ref> it served a similar purpose to [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenters]] and hospitals.<ref name="Desperate Measures" /><ref name="Empire 6" /><ref name="Legacy 42" /> The ''[[Queen of Empire]]'',<ref name="Hero's Trial" /> ''[[FarStar]]'',<ref name="Traitor In Our Midst">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Traitor in our Midst|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> ''[[Reciprocity]]'',<ref name="KOTOR War 3">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 3|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 3]]</ref> [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']],<ref name="Empire 6" /> ''[[Chu'unthor]]'',<ref name="EGTVAV 21" /> ''[[Uwana Buyer]]'',<ref name="Ships of the Smuggler's Alliance" /> and the [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Alliance'']] were examples of ships that had sick bays.<ref name="Legacy 42" /> Furnishings in sick bays included hospital [[Sleeper (furniture)|beds]]<ref name="Empire 6" /><ref name="Legacy 42" /> and [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]], and staff could consist of both [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] and [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]].<ref name="Empire 6" /> Additionally, the sick bay in the [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']]<ref name="Tales of the Golden Droid 83">''[[C-3PO: Tales of the Golden Droid]]'' identifies the ship seen in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' as the ''Redemption''.</ref> included [[ammonia chamber]]s, where [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]]-breathing [[Species/Legends|species]] could recuperate after prolonged exposure to [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]].<ref name="Of Possible Futures">{{StoryCite|story=Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>

Sick bays<ref name="Legacy 42" /> were distinguished from medical [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], which were vessels dedicated primarily to the transportation and care of the wounded and convalescent, and which were primarily staffed by medical personnel.<ref name="CSWE medical frigate">{{CSWECite|II|300|Medical frigate}}</ref> Contrarily, sick bays were usually limited to smaller areas aboard non-medical starships, such as a single room<ref name="Empire 6" /> or wing. The latter was the case with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Chu'unthor]] [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] ship, which housed a medical wing<ref name="EGTVAV 21" /> composed of dozens of healing and hospital rooms. Their purpose was to teach [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] trainees healing arts which they could then use to aid the physically and mentally impaired.<ref name="EGTVAV 20">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'' {{C|"Chu'unthor"}}</ref> Nevertheless, the medical frigate ''Redemption''<ref name="Tales of the Golden Droid 83" /> included a sick bay.<ref name="Of Possible Futures" /> [[Eyrie Base]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] base on the planet [[Karatha]], housed a sick bay despite being a non-mobile location.<ref name="Desperate Measures" />

==History==
{{Dialogue|Solo|You're hurt&mdash;|Showolter|Can't afford the time. Send a med, I'll be all right.|Solo|This man needs to be moved to sick bay. Immediately&mdash;got it?|Steward|Yes, sir, immediately.|attr=Han Solo, Major Showolter, and a [[Unidentified Duros steward|Duros steward]], during a Yuuzhan Vong attack on the ''Queen of Empire''|src=<ref name="Hero's Trial" />}}
In [[3962 BBY]], former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]] pretended that the entire crew of the [[Axehead frigate]] ''Reciprocity'' had been quarantined to the vessel's sick bay as part of a ruse that allowed him to board the [[Phaedacomm]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Phaeda system/Legends|Phaeda system]].<ref name="KOTOR War 3" /> [[Time/Legends|Millennia]] later, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Zahara Cody]] of the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] quarantined several sick crewmembers to the medbay when they became infected with the mysterious disease known as [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|the sickness]].<ref name="Death Troopers">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref> Later on in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Rebel Alliance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] [[Stevan Makintay]] and [[Ketrian Altronel]] planned to raid the sick bay of a [[Unidentified Imperial transport (Hargeeva)|transport]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in order to find an [[Antidote/Legends|antidote]] to the [[xebonica]] [[Poison/Legends|poison]], which had been administered to Altronel, but a rescue by other Alliance agents prevented the need.<ref name="Firepower">{{JournalCite|8|Firepower}}</ref> She was later treated in the sick bay of the Alliance's Eyrie Base, which became the site of a skirmish between Makintay and Imperial [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Nial Pedrin]].<ref name="Desperate Measures" />

[[File:Sickbay.jpg|thumb|left|325px|The ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} medical center]]
The [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] was taken to the ''Redemption''{{'s}} sick bay<ref name="Of Possible Futures" /> in the year [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> after his ammonia-breathing [[Lung/Legends|lungs]] received oxygen burns. While he recovered, a ceremony was held in sick bay to promote Rebel agent [[Toryn Farr/Legends|Toryn Farr]] to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Commander/Legends|commander]]&mdash;she insisted on the location so as to allow Zuckuss to attend. While the Gand was in an ammonia chamber, the famous Rebel [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was in the sick bay's solarium<ref name="Of Possible Futures" /> receiving a new [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Limb/Legends|hand]].<ref name="Empire">{{Film|V}}</ref>

During the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Talon Karrde]] employed a [[Unidentified Twi'lek masseuse|Twi'lek masseuse]] aboard his [[Luxury 5000]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]], the ''Uwana Buyer''. As she was using the salary to pay her way through medical [[school]], she also worked as a doctor in the ship's medical bay.<ref name="Ships of the Smuggler's Alliance" /> The CR90 [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''FarStar'' [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]] was confined to sick bay in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] after being rendered [[Coma/Legends|comatose]] by a [[Sebiris poison|poison]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sebiris]],<ref name="Traitor In Our Midst" /> and the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] saw [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Showolter]] of the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] sent to the [[Luxury liner/Legends|Luxury liner]] ''Queen of Empire''{{'s}} sick bay by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], captain of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], after being injured in an attack by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Warrior caste|warriors]].<ref name="Hero's Trial" /> The ''[[Jade Shadow]]'', personal starship of [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], had a medbay, where [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Luke Skywalker left his corporeal body in the year [[43 ABY]] while walking [[beyond shadows]].<ref name="Abyss chapter">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>

In [[137 ABY]], during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] was betrayed and shot by [[Shipman]] [[Tealart]] aboard the [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]] ''Alliance''. Gravely injured, the Admiral was confined to sick bay and treated by the [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healer]] [[Sayar Dun'La]] while Captain [[Jhoram Bey]] took command of the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]] during a subsequent [[Attack on the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet|space battle]] with the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|forces]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. Bey's attempts to flee into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] were repeatedly thwarted by the pursuing Imperials, and when Stazi figured out that the enemy was tracing the frequency vibrations of the ''Alliance''{{'s}} [[Communications array/Legends|communications array]], he was barely able to whisper as much to Bey from his hospital bed. The revelation allowed Bey to thwart the Imperials and win the day.<ref name="Legacy 42" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Star Trek'' and ''Star Wars'' helped several generations create a visual images ''[sic]'' of health care's future that include diagnostic "wands," sick-bay beds with magical sensors, needle-free injections, virtual doctors, robot nurses, and much more.|Douglas E. Goldstein, in his book ''Medical Informatics 20/20''|<ref name="Medical Informatics" />}}
[[File:Doctorcrusher.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[http://en.memory-alpha.org/wiki/Beverly_Crusher Dr. Beverly Crusher] operates in sick bay in [http://en.memory-alpha.org/wiki/Lonely_Among_Us_%28episode%29 an episode] of ''[http://en.memory-alpha.org/wiki/Star_Trek:_The_Next_Generation Star Trek: The Next Generation]''.]]
Sick bays have appeared in a wide variety of ''[[Star Wars]]'' multimedia, referred to by varying names including sickbay and medbay.<ref name="Desperate Measures" /><ref name="Empire 6" /><ref name="Legacy 42" /> In real life, sick bay is a nautical term dating back to the [[Wikipedia:Age of Sail|days of sail]]. As there were relatively few places on shore where ill seamen could be treated, most ships had sick berths located in the vessel's stern. The name "sick bay" was derived from the stern's rounded contours, which suggested the shape of a bay.<ref name="Origin of Name">{{WebCite|url=http://www.history.navy.mil/library/online/origin.htm#sic|text=Origin of Navy Terminology|work=The Navy Department Library|archivedate=20130114221757}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster's]] Dictionary defines sick bay as "a compartment in a ship used as a dispensary and hospital," and, more broadly, "a place for the care of the sick or injured."<ref name="Merriam-Webster">{{WebCite|url=http://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/sick%20bay|text=Sick bay - Definition|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster's]] Dictionary|archivedate=20130115105537}}</ref> For example, the [[Wikipedia:United States Navy|United States Navy's]] [[Wikipedia:USS Constitution|USS ''Constitution'']], the oldest commissioned warship afloat in the entire world, includes a sick bay in the fore of the vessel's berth deck that was historically used to treat sailors injured in battle and by various maladies.<ref name="USS Constitution">{{YouTube|video=gpEmrQqzRbQ|text=USS Constitution's Sick Bay|channel=SleepyTymeT|name=SleepyTymeT|date=2010-05-30}}</ref>

Sick bays and medical bays are recurring themes in the [[Wikipedia:Science fiction|science fiction]] and space [[Wikipedia:Fantasy|fantasy]] genres&mdash;in addition to ''Star Wars'', they have appeared in such franchises as [[Wikipedia:Star Trek|''Star Trek'']],<ref name="Medical Informatics">{{WebCite|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=JivKd9gTA5cC&pg=PT572|text=Medical Informatics 20/20|author=Douglas E. Goldstein|archivedate=20200819132503}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:Battlestar Galactica|''Battlestar Galactica'']],<ref name="Battlestar Sick Bay">{{VisualMediaCite|title=[[Wikipedia:Battlestar Galactica (2004 TV series)|''Battlestar Galactica'']]|episode=The Captain's Hand|director=[[Wikipedia:Sergio Mimica-Gezzan|Sergio Mimica-Gezzan]]|prod=David Eick Productions|year=[[2006]]}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:Mass Effect|''Mass Effect'']],<ref name="Mass Effect">{{WebCite|url=http://www.supercheats.com/guides/mass-effect/noveria|text=Noveria - Mass Effect|author=Michael Monette|work=Super Cheats|archivedate=20081008001714}}</ref> and [[Wikipedia:Farscape|''Farscape'']].<ref name="Farscape">{{WebCite|url=http://www.tor.com/blogs/2012/11/farscape-rewatch-beware-of-dog|text=''Farscape'' Rewatch: "Beware of Dog"|author=Scott K. Andrews|work=<nowiki></nowiki>''Farscape'' Rewatch on Tor.com|archivedate=20130512120404}}</ref> In his book ''Medical Informatics 20/20'', author Douglas E. Goldstein credits the sick bays seen in the ''Wars'' and ''Trek'' franchises with helping inspire the future of health care.<ref name="Medical Informatics" /> Similarly, a high-tech disease detection facility unveiled by the [[Wikipedia:University of Leicester|University of Leicester]] in [[2011]] was called a "Science-Fiction Style 'Sick Bay'" by [[Wikipedia:Medical News Today|Medical News Today]]<ref name="Medical news Today">{{WebCite|url=http://www.medicalnewstoday.com/releases/233729.php|text=Leicester Scientists Deploy Space-Age Technologies At Science-Fiction Style 'Sick Bay'|date=2011-09-02|work=[[Wikipedia:Medical News Today|Medical News Today]]|archivedate=20111018023403}}</ref> and a "sickbay that uses space-age technology" by the [[Wikipedia:Daily Mail|''Daily Mail'']].<ref name="Daily Mail">{{WebCite|url=http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-2032378/Space-age-sickbay-diagnoses-disease-need-tests.html|text=The space-age sickbay that diagnoses disease without need for tests from sight, smell and 'feel' of disease|author=Fiona Macrae|date=2011-09-01|work=[[Wikipedia:Daily Mail|Daily Mail]]|archivedate=20130311013922}}</ref>
